summary.text: Jeff Weninger, a Republican, represents District 13 in the Arizona House of Representatives and is not running for re-election to it in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he ran for mayor of Chandler and lost in the July 21, 2026 primary.
His legislative biography says he previously represented District 17 in the House for four terms and served eight years on the Chandler City Council, including as vice mayor.
Weninger was born in Wichita, Kansas, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as restaurant owner.
